modelspec.data.ParamInitDirectory.title: ParamInitDirectory
modelspec.data.ParamInitDirectory.description: The directory `modelspec train --init <dir>` names; one ParamInitFile per parameter it overrides. A partial match is allowed, a parameter with no file keeping its initializer, and a file that names no parameter is ignored. A directory that cannot be read, or that holds no ParamInitFile of any parameter, is refused with E-DATA-007 before the first step.
x-ess-invariants: distinct file in files by file.path

modelspec.data.ParamInitFile.title: ParamInitFile
modelspec.data.ParamInitFile.description:
One file `

.f32` of the directory `modelspec train --init

` names (DESIGN.md § 8), where p is a parameter's canonical path without its leading model name (`w1` for `Mnist.w1`). Row-major little-endian f32 with no header, exactly elements values, the parameter's element count; the parameter starts from these values instead of its initializer. Another length, or a value that is NaN or infinite, is refused with E-DATA-007 before the first step. A parameter with no file keeps its initializer.
